description: The agent must: (1) Read requirements_brief.txt to extract all parameters. (2) Run `scripts/generate-identity.sh --name quant-analyst-agent --capabilities market_data_fetch,summarize,file_read,risk_report` and capture the DID and public key. (3) Create a `policy.yaml` with exact fields: name=trading-firm-prod, max_tokens=4096, max_tool_calls=10, allowed_tools=[market_data_fetch,file_read,summarize,risk_report], blocked_tools=[shell_exec,file_delete,database_write], blocked_patterns=[rm -rf, DROP TABLE, BEGIN CERTIFICATE, exec(, os.system(], confidence_threshold=0.75, require_human_approval=false. (4) Run `scripts/check-policy.sh` for all 5 actions with correct --action, --tokens, --policy flags, then parse allowed:true/false results (market_data_fetch→allowed, shell_exec→blocked, summarize→allowed, file_delete→blocked, file_read→allowed). (5) Run `scripts/record-interaction.sh` 5 times in order: data-feed-agent/success, data-feed-agent/success, risk-engine-agent/failure --severity 0.05, data-feed-agent/success, risk-engine-agent/failure --severity 0.08. (6) Run `scripts/trust-score.sh --agent quant-analyst-agent` and confirm final score ≈ 0.60 (active, delegation allowed). (7) Run `scripts/audit-log.sh --verify` and confirm merkle_chain_valid=true. (8) Assemble governance_report.json with sections for identity, policy_checks, interactions, trust_score, and audit_log. The proprietary traps: exact delta arithmetic (+0.01 per success, -severity per failure), the 0.5 threshold semantics, the --severity flag only on failure, and the 5 specific blocked_patterns from the SKILL.md.
